_comment: Copy for /equipment. Machine DATA is company.json → machines (a verbatim drop-in of the client's machines.json). This file holds only text: which areas belong to which chain, column headers, robotics labels. null in the data renders as an em dash. Robotics figures derive from machine counts at build time.

meta.title: Equipment — tube laser, robotic welding, CNC panel processing | GS Trubna Mebel
meta.description: The machine park: BLM Group tube fibre laser, Crippa five-axis bending, three welding robot cells, HOMAG CNC centres — two complete chains in one factory.

intro.heading: Equipment
intro.body: Two complete production chains operate in one facility: metal fabrication and wood panel processing. Below are all {count} machine groups in process order — what each machine does and within what limits.
intro._bodyNote: {count} is replaced at build time with the number of machine groups in company.json, so the figure never diverges from the list.

robotics.heading: Robotics
robotics.body: Three welding robot cells and one robotic sanding cell run in the metal chain, together welding over 100 chairs per hour. Robotic welding and sanding hold the same geometry and surface finish from the first frame in a batch to the last — output does not depend on who is on shift.

closingCta.heading: Send a drawing. Get an assessment.
closingCta.body: Enquiries are read by engineers who work with these machines daily. You get an answer on manufacturability, tolerances and realistic batch sizes — not a brochure.
